video_title: 🚨EMERGENCY POD🚨 NBA Announces Clippers’ Punishments After Kawhi Probe Reaction

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Steve Ballmer's punishment for lack of institutional control
quotes.excerpt: Steve Ballmer was not accused of much direct wrongdoing. He was accused or maybe even convicted of lack of institutional control.

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: Steve Ballmer was not accused of much direct wrongdoing. He was accused or maybe even convicted of lack of institutional control. They basically said, you should have known and we think you kind of did know. They don't really accuse him of direct wrongdoing.

text_blocks.speaker: Sam Amick
text_blocks.text: The exact language of the NBA's press release is Ballmer is suspended from all league and team activities for one year for knowingly seeking to help Kawhi Leonard obtain off-court income opportunities, for approving a business deal that he knew was a precondition for Aspiration to enter into an endorsement agreement with Mr. Leonard, and for his failure to create conditions under which his organization abided by the NBA's circumvention rules.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Gillian Zucker's role in the Clippers' punishment
quotes.excerpt: Gillian Zucker, they call her essentially a liar and obfuscator, a rule breaker. They implicate indirectly her husband.

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: Gillian Zucker, they call her essentially a liar and obfuscator, a rule breaker. They implicate indirectly her husband. She was suspended without pay for a year for being primarily and directly culpable for the impermissible endorsement arrangements and for providing false and misleading statements to investigators.

text_blocks.speaker: Sam Amick
text_blocks.text: Clipper President of Basketball Operations Lawrence Frank is suspended without pay for six months for his involvement with the impermissible endorsement arrangements and for approving impermissible expenses incurred by Mr. Leonard and his family.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: The Clippers' argument against the NBA's findings
quotes.excerpt: The Clippers are not denying that these endorsement deals happened. They're not denying that Kawhi got this money.
quotes.quote: The Clippers put out a statement and basically what it looks like is that the Clippers are not denying that these endorsement deals happened. They're not denying that Kawhi got this money. They're not denying that these are companies. I mean, Boingo Wireless does advertise, but they don't advertise, they've never advertised with NBA endorsers that I'm aware of. There's also the little thing of typically when you sign a guy to a multi-million dollar endorsement deal, he actually endorses something.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: The core of the Clippers' defense
quotes.excerpt: The Clippers are saying that, yeah, these companies did business with Kawhi, but we are allowed to introduce companies.
quotes.quote: The Clippers are saying that, yeah, these companies did business with Kawhi, but we are allowed to introduce companies if the companies want to meet him or if Kawhi wants to meet them. Or if Dactronics said, hey, we think that Kawhi is a dynamic guy, we love the way he looks on our scoreboards, can you get us in touch with him and we can do a deal? The Clippers are saying that that's what they did, that they acted as the middleman and they operated within the rules.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Why the Clippers were incentivized to make the deal
quotes.excerpt: They were highly, highly incentivized to do this deal with the Clippers because Dactronics had hit a rough patch.
quotes.quote: They were highly, highly incentivized to do this deal with the Clippers because Dactronics had hit a rough patch and really kind of needed the deal. I mean, anybody could use a $100 million order, but in that particular point, their finances were struggling, so they needed to do it. And the details in this report make it clear that Dactronics basically opened up and said what happened.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Kawhi Leonard's statement on the investigation
quotes.excerpt: Kawhi put out a statement which, by the way, has an absolute incredible line in it.
quotes.quote: Kawhi put out a statement which, by the way, has an absolute incredible line in it. I'd like to break down the Kawhi statement. Integrity and respect for this game are fundamental to who I am. That is absolutely never going to be true again. I accept full responsibility for lapses in judgment by people within my inner circle and regret the distraction this situation has caused the fans and my family.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.excerpt: The Clippers are saying we're going to try every legal avenue we can to fight this.
quotes.quote: The Clippers are saying we're going to try every legal avenue we can to fight this. They're basically like, we're going to fight. And my guess is that the fight is going to be over the words affirmative and responsive. But let me tell you something, here is my unsolicited advice to the Clippers organization: Accept the penalty and ask for one provision, that no more penalties are levied.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: The Timberwolves' salary cap circumvention penalty
quotes.excerpt: What were the Timberwolves' penalty in 2000 when the Joe Smith salary cap circumvention happened?
quotes.quote: What were the Timberwolves' penalty in 2000 when the Joe Smith salary cap circumvention happened? Five first-round picks originally. And the contract was nuked. They no longer had the player.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.excerpt: Kawhi is free to be traded with a clean slate.
quotes.quote: Kawhi is free to be traded with a clean slate. And they're going to get two first-round picks for him, assuming that the deal is done. They're going to have the Raptors' pick in 29 and 31. And they're going to have their pick in 27 and their pick in 29.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.excerpt: They're throwing the Paul George trade in and they're saying Kawhi cost them 10 firsts and two swaps.
quotes.quote: They're throwing the Paul George trade in and they're saying Kawhi cost them 10 firsts and two swaps. And they're saying that the Clippers are saying that they've already paid $15 million for the legal fees for this and there were six law firms involved.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Lawrence Frank's role in the investigation
quotes.excerpt: Lawrence Frank was told to basically stay home and file reports. And apparently he did.
quotes.quote: Lawrence Frank was told to basically stay home and file reports. And apparently he did. I don't think anybody ever read them, but he was home filing reports. So he was taking notes about Uncle Dennis making demands.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.excerpt: The Clippers say that they had already paid $15 million for the legal fees for this.
quotes.quote: The Clippers say that they had already paid $15 million for the legal fees for this and there were six law firms involved. My advice is don't do extraordinarily shady stuff that requires a legal team this type of investigation.
